title: Manufacturing
summary: Capabilities of a discrete or process manufacturer: product design, production planning and execution, quality, maintenance and the supply chain.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a manufacturing company. Vocabulary drawn from ISA-95 and common product-lifecycle and supply-chain references (consulted, not copied). Draft only: written by Claude for the Atlas demo and not yet reviewed by a domain expert.

sources.citation: ISA-95 enterprise-control integration and common product-lifecycle and supply-chain vocabulary (consulted for vocabulary; not copied)
sources.reviewedBy: Pending review (drafted by Claude for the Atlas demo)

items.name: Finance
items.description: Planning, controlling and accounting for the organisation's money and financial risk.

items.name: Financial Planning & Budgeting
items.description: Setting medium-term financial plans and annual budgets aligned to priorities.

items.name: Financial Accounting & Reporting
items.description: Recording transactions and producing statutory accounts and management reports.

items.name: Treasury & Cash Management
items.description: Managing cash, borrowing, investments and liquidity to meet obligations.

items.name: Payments & Receivables
items.description: Paying suppliers and collecting income owed to the organisation.

items.name: Financial Control & Audit Support
items.description: Maintaining internal controls and evidence for internal and external audit.

items.name: Human Resources
items.description: Attracting, developing, rewarding and retaining the people the organisation needs.

items.name: Workforce Planning
items.description: Forecasting the roles, numbers and skills the organisation will need.

items.name: Recruitment & Onboarding
items.description: Sourcing, selecting and settling new people into their roles.

items.name: Learning & Development
items.description: Building the skills, knowledge and behaviours the workforce needs.

items.name: Pay, Reward & Pensions
items.description: Administering pay, benefits and pension arrangements accurately and on time.

items.name: Employee Relations & Wellbeing
items.description: Supporting fair treatment, health, safety and engagement of employees.

items.name: Procurement
items.description: Obtaining goods, works and services that offer value for money and manage supply risk.

items.name: Category & Sourcing Strategy
items.description: Deciding how each category of spend is best sourced and competed.

items.name: Tendering & Contract Award
items.description: Running compliant competitions and awarding contracts to suppliers.

items.name: Contract & Supplier Management
items.description: Managing supplier performance, relationships and risk through the contract life.

items.name: Spend Control & Compliance
items.description: Ensuring purchases follow policy, thresholds and approved suppliers.

items.name: Information Management
items.description: Governing, protecting and exploiting the organisation's information as an asset.

items.name: Records Management
items.description: Creating, keeping and disposing of records according to retention rules.

items.name: Data Governance & Quality
items.description: Defining ownership, standards and quality controls for the organisation's data.

items.name: Information Rights & Access
items.description: Meeting freedom of information, subject access and transparency obligations.

items.name: Data Protection & Privacy
items.description: Ensuring personal data is processed lawfully, securely and proportionately.

items.name: Analytics & Business Intelligence
items.description: Turning data into insight that informs decisions and performance management.

items.name: Customer Contact
items.description: Handling enquiries, requests and feedback from the people the organisation serves.

items.name: Contact Channels
items.description: Providing phone, digital, post and face-to-face channels for contact.

items.name: Identity & Account Verification
items.description: Confirming who a customer is before acting on their behalf.

items.name: Case & Request Tracking
items.description: Recording each request and its progress until it is resolved.

items.name: Complaints & Feedback
items.description: Receiving, investigating and learning from complaints and compliments.

items.name: Accessibility & Inclusion
items.description: Making contact usable for people with different needs and languages.

items.name: Estates
items.description: Providing, operating and maintaining the buildings and land the organisation occupies.

items.name: Property Portfolio & Strategy
items.description: Deciding which properties to hold, acquire, adapt or release.

items.name: Facilities & Building Operations
items.description: Running buildings day to day: cleaning, security, utilities and reception.

items.name: Maintenance & Compliance
items.description: Keeping buildings safe, compliant and in good repair over their life.

items.name: Space & Workplace
items.description: Allocating and configuring space to how people actually work.

items.name: Energy & Sustainability
items.description: Reducing the energy, carbon and environmental impact of the estate.

items.name: Digital & Technology
items.description: Delivering and running the technology and digital services the organisation depends on.

items.name: Enterprise Architecture & Standards
items.description: Setting the target technology landscape and the standards it follows.

items.name: Application Delivery & Support
items.description: Building, buying, integrating and supporting the applications the business runs on.

items.name: Infrastructure, Cloud & Networks
items.description: Providing the compute, storage, hosting and connectivity services rely on.

items.name: Cyber Security & Resilience
items.description: Protecting systems and data from threats and recovering from disruption.

items.name: Digital Service Design
items.description: Designing user-centred digital services around real user needs.

items.name: Technology Service Management
items.description: Handling incidents, requests, changes and problems across live services.

items.name: Governance & Assurance
items.description: Directing the organisation and assuring that it is well run, lawful and accountable.

items.name: Strategy & Performance
items.description: Setting direction and measuring progress against agreed outcomes.

items.name: Risk Management
items.description: Identifying, assessing and treating the risks that threaten objectives.

items.name: Internal Audit & Assurance
items.description: Independently checking that controls work and reporting on them.

items.name: Legal & Regulatory Compliance
items.description: Meeting the laws, regulations and statutory duties that apply.

items.name: Corporate Governance
items.description: Operating the board, committees and scheme of delegation transparently.

items.name: Business Continuity & Emergency Planning
items.description: Preparing to keep essential activity going through disruption.

items.name: Product Design & Engineering
items.description: Designing products and managing their definition through life.

items.name: Product Lifecycle Management
items.description: Managing product definitions, versions and documents from concept through to withdrawal.

items.name: Engineering Change Management
items.description: Controlling proposed changes to a product design and recording their impact before approval.

items.name: Bill of Materials Management
items.description: Maintaining the structured list of parts, materials and quantities that make up each product.

items.name: Simulation & Testing
items.description: Predicting and proving product behaviour through simulation, prototypes and test.

items.name: Regulatory & Standards Compliance
items.description: Making sure products meet the regulations and standards that apply to them.

items.name: Production Planning & Execution
items.description: Planning what to make and running the shop floor to deliver it.

items.name: Demand & Capacity Planning
items.description: Forecasting demand and matching it to available capacity, materials and labour.

items.name: Production Scheduling
items.description: Sequencing orders across lines and machines to meet delivery dates.

items.name: Shop Floor Execution
items.description: Running production orders on the shop floor and recording what is made.

items.name: Traceability & Genealogy
items.description: Recording which materials, machines and people went into each batch or unit.

items.name: Process Control & Automation
items.description: Monitoring and adjusting machines and processes so they run within set limits.

items.name: Quality & Compliance
items.description: Making sure products meet specification and standards.

items.name: Quality Management
items.description: Defining quality plans and standards and monitoring performance against them.

items.name: Inspection & Non-Conformance
items.description: Checking products against specification and handling those that fail.

items.name: Supplier Quality
items.description: Assessing and improving the quality of what suppliers deliver.

items.name: Calibration & Audit
items.description: Keeping measuring equipment accurate and checking that quality procedures are followed.

items.name: Product Recall Management
items.description: Identifying affected products and withdrawing or correcting them when a defect is found.

items.name: Maintenance & Asset Performance
items.description: Keeping plant and equipment available and safe.

items.name: Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
items.description: Planning servicing and repairs, based on schedules and equipment condition, to avoid breakdowns.

items.name: Spare Parts Management
items.description: Holding and issuing the spare parts needed to keep equipment running.

items.name: Equipment Performance Monitoring
items.description: Measuring how well equipment is running, how often it stops and why.

items.name: Energy & Utilities Management
items.description: Managing and reducing the energy, water and other utilities that production consumes.

items.name: Plant Health & Safety
items.description: Keeping people safe around plant and equipment and meeting health and safety duties.

items.name: Supply Chain & Logistics
items.description: Sourcing materials and delivering finished goods.

items.name: Supplier Management & Sourcing
items.description: Choosing, contracting with and managing the suppliers of materials and components.

items.name: Materials Planning
items.description: Working out which materials are needed, in what quantity and by when.

items.name: Warehousing & Inventory
items.description: Storing materials and finished goods and keeping accurate stock records.

items.name: Outbound Logistics
items.description: Moving finished goods to customers and distribution points.

items.name: Order Management & Customer Delivery
items.description: Taking customer orders and managing them through to delivery and invoicing.

valueStreams.name: Design to Release
valueStreams.description: Starts when a new product or change is proposed. Ends when the design is verified and released to production.

valueStreams.name: Plan to Produce
valueStreams.description: Starts when demand is forecast. Ends when orders are scheduled and made.

valueStreams.name: Assure Quality
valueStreams.description: Starts when production output or supplier deliveries are checked. Ends when they meet specification or non-conformances are under control.

valueStreams.name: Source to Deliver
valueStreams.description: Starts when materials are sourced. Ends when finished goods are stored and shipped to the customer.
